notes.title: Version 1.1.0 brings BEATinf. and scalable window size
notes.notes:
Hi players!

Ekstase keeps on getting better with the latest update introducing a new game mode and adding scalable windowed mode. 

Introducing BEATinf., Ekstase's new beat mode. 

Elleraiser requested an endless BEAT99 mode. I thought that would be cool too, so I patched it in. Think of it as free dlc ;). 
In BEATinf.  you have to move on the beat. With every successful drop, your multiplier increases. But when you miss a beat, the multiplier goes back to 1x! 

Nick requested a scalable windowed mode. This also solves the issues some other people had with non-traditional screen sizes. So, download the latest update and give it a try!

Have fun playing!

notes.title: V1.0.9 brings cross-platform leaderboards
notes.notes:
With V1.0.9 I added cross-platform leaderboards. 

This way, no matter the platform, Steam or otherwise, all highscores get uploaded to the same place. CONVENIENT!

notes.title: V108 out now :)!
notes.notes:
A nice little improvement (that took actually quite some work ha!):
The special blocks (or bombs) are now visible in the NEXT section in the UI. 

Also, fixes of these bugs:
- Self-selected colors in color blindness mode get reset to do default after reentering the accessibility menu.
- Back button is not clickable in game selection screen.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.0.7c
notes.notes:
Hi Ekstase players! Update v1.0.7c brings many improvements <3


Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] When you entered Beat99 for the first time, it booted classic mode instead. This is now fixed :).
[*] The game looked bad on screens with a 32:9 resolution. No longer!
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Load times: there are virtually no load times any more, regardless of whether you are playing Ekstase on a high-end pc or something older
[*] UI navigation improvements
[*] Songs can be selected now from the game mode screen!
[*] Beat99 is slightly more forgiving with timing.
[/list]

Accessibility:
[list]
[*] In beat99, controllers can be set to vibrate to the beat. 
[*] Level 0 is now literally “level 0” meaning that blocks don’t fall unless you tell them to! Combining this with “don’t level up” creates a super chill mode. 
[/list]

Oh yeah, the game is almost a gig smaller! :)

notes.title: Small update and the demo is back!
notes.notes:
V1.0.6 is out now!

This small update brings a huge improvement to the music transitions! 

- songs are now mixed better 
- beat detection during song change is now more accurate in beat99


The demo is back! 
- In the demo you can play the first level of Time Attack Mode.
- Both turn mode A (shift colors) and B (rotate shapes) are available to try out.

notes.title: New Leader Boards, achievements and bug fixes.
notes.notes:
V1.0.5 comes with the following changes:
Beat99
- new leader boards for Beat99
- a new achievement for completing Beat99 without missing a beat

Bug fixes
- Before it was impossible to unlock the hidden achievement, this is now fixed. 
- There was an issue with the audio not playing upon the first installation of the game. Fixed!
- I improved the navigation in the accessibility menu.
